name: agent-commerce-middleman
description: Deterministic Guardrails, Policy Engine, and Razorpay Payment Gateway for Autonomous AI Agents

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && concurrently -n "API,DASHBOARD" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "node --watch apps/api/src/index.js" "npm run dev --workspace=dashboard"
scripts.dev:all: docker compose up -d && concurrently -n "API,DASHBOARD,STUDIO" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "node --watch apps/api/src/index.js" "npm run dev --workspace=dashboard" "prisma studio --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma"

author: Shikharyadav25
